identity.title: [v0.92.1][CORP-07] Move Terraform CI deployment and runbook authority

values.summary: Place Terraform state and deployment authority under company custody, use short-lived least-privilege CI identity, and prove a clean operator can deploy and roll back using complete redacted runbooks.

steps.action: Require terminal CORP-05 and CORP-06, inventory Terraform state/locks, deployment environments, OIDC roles, workflow permissions, secret names, and rollback owners.
Move or verify state and lock custody under company authority, exercise readback and contention, and prove recovery without founder-local state or credentials.
Configure and inspect company-controlled OIDC or equivalent short-lived deployment identity against the reviewed least-privilege permission set.
Author deployment and rollback runbooks with prerequisites, one command per operation, expected outputs, cleanup, monitoring, and escalation while naming secrets only.
Have an authorized clean operator execute plan/apply/deploy and rollback from the runbooks with no unrecorded manual step or personal credential.
Capture state, lock, identity, deployment, rollback, and cleanup receipts; fail on personal dependencies, excess permissions, ambiguous state custody, or non-executable rollback.
Complete exact-head review and publish the redacted authority manifest and proven runbooks after restoring the approved production posture.

invariants: Issue CORP-07 owns only its declared repository paths and named external operation/evidence boundary.
Dependencies remain read-only inputs until terminal evidence satisfies the declared gate.
The issue may not absorb remediation owned by another work package without an explicit issue-graph revision.
No unsupported completion, legal, production, or release claim
No mutation outside exact owned paths
risks: A passing artifact could overstate production, legal, or release authority.
Path or external-account overlap could collide with another active issue.
Evidence could become stale if it is not tied to exact revisions and producer outcomes.
stop_conditions: Workflow permissions exceed the reviewed role
